title: Towards Region-aware Bias Evaluation Metrics
benchmark_measurement: Detection of gender stereotypes where religious/spiritual topics (e.g., Christian theology, religious devotion, spirituality) are associated with the male gender across different geographical regions.
findings: Across multiple global regions (Africa, Asia, Europe, North America, Oceania), topics related to religion, spirituality, and Christian theology were automatically identified as being stereotypically associated with men. Human validation tests confirmed that some of these religion-gender associations represent stronger biases than the standard family-career stereotype.
